title: lp2106791/noble → ubuntu/noble-updates
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 2b32e0a..bca616d 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,12 @@
+libvirt (10.0.0-2ubuntu8.8) noble; urgency=medium
+
+ * Fix detection of SapphireRapids (LP: #2106791)
+   - d/rules,d/libvirt0.postinst: Request msr module to be loaded
+     The module msr is needed by libvirt to read MSR registers
+     and detect some CPU features.
+
+ -- Hector Cao <hector.cao@canonical.com>  Wed, 21 May 2025 02:42:16 +0000
+
 libvirt (10.0.0-2ubuntu8.7) noble; urgency=medium
 
   [ Heinrich Schuchardt ]
diff --git a/debian/libvirt0.postinst b/debian/libvirt0.postinst
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..fa930f5
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/libvirt0.postinst
@@ -0,0 +1,34 @@
+#!/bin/sh
+
+set -e
+
+# summary of how this script can be called:
+#        * <postinst> `configure' <most-recently-configured-version>
+#        * <old-postinst> `abort-upgrade' <new version>
+#        * <conflictor's-postinst> `abort-remove' `in-favour' <package>
+#          <new-version>
+#        * <postinst> `abort-remove'
+#        * <deconfigured's-postinst> `abort-deconfigure' `in-favour'
+#          <failed-install-package> <version> `removing'
+#          <conflicting-package> <version>
+# for details, see https://www.debian.org/doc/debian-policy/ or
+# the debian-policy package
+
+case "$1" in
+    configure)
+        # Load the msr module (LP: #2106791)
+        modprobe msr || true
+    ;;
+
+    abort-upgrade|abort-remove|abort-deconfigure)
+    ;;
+
+    *)
+        echo "postinst called with unknown argument \`$1'" >&2
+        exit 1
+    ;;
+esac
+
+#DEBHELPER#
+
+exit 0
diff --git a/debian/local/modules-load.conf b/debian/local/modules-load.conf
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3e5ee7f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/local/modules-load.conf
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+msr
diff --git a/debian/rules b/debian/rules
index fadb91a..c7b12bb 100755
--- a/debian/rules
+++ b/debian/rules
@@ -319,6 +319,14 @@ ifeq ($(DEB_HOST_ARCH_OS), linux)
 	mkdir -p debian/tmp/etc/profile.d
 	cp -f debian/libvirt-uri.sh debian/tmp/etc/profile.d/
 
+ifneq ($(filter $(DEB_HOST_ARCH),amd64 i386),)
+	# Add msr module to be loaded at boot
+	# Since the msr read functionality is in libvirt0, we install the modules-load.d file
+	# as part of the libvirt0 binary package
+	mkdir -p debian/libvirt0/usr/lib/modules-load.d/
+	install -D -m 644 debian/local/modules-load.conf debian/libvirt0/usr/lib/modules-load.d/libvirt.conf
+endif
+
 	# Disable network autostart
 	rm -rf $(DEB_DESTDIR)/etc/libvirt/qemu/networks/autostart/
